verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Brex has a developer API portal with REST endpoints (Accounting, Budgets, Webhooks, Team APIs) and a quickstart guide, plus an llms.txt and MCP server reference, but nothing indicates official client SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Java libraries) for building against the API — the OpenAPI spec itself even 404s. Missing for 10: any mention of official SDK packages/libraries, language-specific client libraries, or SDK documentation/versioning.
